name: handoff
description: /handoff records the session as background context for a later session, never a task or a plan, and saves it as a Markdown file under ~/.local/share/handoffs/<project>/; save only saves it; list and resume [id] [extra context] revisit this project's handoffs; before a recap is saved its open questions are asked and the answers kept as decisions; resume fills the handoff into the composer of a fresh session and sends nothing; save and resume with nothing after them open a box for notes: for save the recap writer takes them as context and words them itself, for resume they are added under the handoff, and resume's box lists the handoffs to pick from

writer.title: Recap writer
writer.description: Who writes the recap. subagent (the default) starts a Haiku subagent, which also works behind an API proxy that refuses background requests. haiku asks Haiku in the background first and starts the subagent when the API refuses. With both, the session's own model first judges and asks the open questions in a short turn. conversation has the session's own model ask and write the recap in one normal turn.
